mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (id, order_number, user_id, merchant_id, product_detail_id, quantity, total_price, status, coupon_id, discount_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNumber}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{productDetailId}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{couponId}, #{discountAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `order` WHERE status = 'WAIT_BUYER_PAY' AND gmt_created < #{expireTime} ORDER BY gmt_created ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = #{targetStatus}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber} AND status = 'WAIT_BUYER_PAY'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND gmt_created >= #{after}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) FROM `order` WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) FROM `order` WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = #{status} AND gmt_created >= #{after}
SELECT FROM `order` ORDER BY gmt_created DESC

SELECT DATE(gmt_created) AS day, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS salesAmount FROM `order` WHERE status = #{status} AND gmt_created >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(gmt_created) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT p.brand AS brand, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM `order` o JOIN product_detail pd ON o.product_detail_id = pd.id JOIN product p ON pd.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('TRADE_CLOSED') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY orderCount DESC, brand ASC LIMIT #{limit}
